summary: Build a movie website called "movie sphere" with admin-only access for uploading movies.
architectural_notes: Implement role-based access control (admin-only) for movie upload/manage features.
Admin-only UI controls must gate movie file attachment upload; non-admin users should not see or access upload endpoints.

existing_features.title: Create a movie website named "Movie Sphere" with a public catalog where unauthenticated visitors can browse movies and open a movie detail page to watch the movie.
Implement authentication using Internet Identity and establish an admin role so that only the admin can create/update/delete movie entries.
Add an admin-only movie upload/manage experience that allows the admin to add movies with metadata (title, description, poster image URL, video URL) and to edit or remove existing movies.

Establish a coherent, distinct visual theme for Movie Sphere (colors, typography, layout, components) and apply it consistently across the catalog, detail, and admin pages (avoid blue/purple as primary colors).
Render generated static image assets (logo and a cinematic background) from frontend/public/assets/generated in the app shell (header/landing) without routing images through the backend.

Add an admin-only movie video file attachment upload capability: provide backend APIs for the admin to upload a movie video file (as bytes) and store it in-canister, and allow the frontend to play the uploaded file from MovieDetailPage without requiring an external video URL.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create a movie website named "movie sphere"
Admin account for the user and restrict movie uploading to admin-only

Provide a secure admin bootstrap flow so the user can become admin without requiring code changes: if no admin is set yet, the first authenticated principal to claim admin becomes the admin; once set, admin cannot be overwritten by non-admins.
Add an admin-only movie file attachment upload option in the movie upload/manage UI (visible and usable only by the admin).

Ensure there is exactly one admin for Movie Sphere (the site owner) by implementing a secure admin bootstrap flow: if no admin is set yet, the first authenticated principal to claim admin becomes the permanent admin; once set, non-admin principals must never be able to overwrite or claim admin.
